section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Differential
title: REPLACEMENT OF FRONT OIL SEAL COMPONENTS

content.description: Exploded view of front oil seal components showing companion flange, oil seal, oil slinger, front bearing, spacer, and differential housing assembly
Illustration showing SST tool being used to remove oil seal from differential housing

items.text: REMOVE COMPANION FLANGE (See step 10 on page RA-24)

substeps.label: (a)
substeps.text: Using SST, remove the oil seal from the housing.

items.text: REMOVE FRONT BEARING AND BEARING SPACER (See step 12 on page RA-25)
INSTALL NEW BEARING SPACER AND FRONT BEARING

substeps.label: (a)
substeps.text: Install a new bearing spacer on the shaft.

substeps.label: (b)
substeps.text: Install the front bearing on the shaft.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of new bearing spacer on differential shaft

items.text: INSTALL OIL SLINGER AND NEW OIL SEAL

substeps.label: (a)
substeps.text: Install the oil slinger facing as shown.

substeps.label: (b)
substeps.text: Using SST, drive in a new oil seal.

items.label: (c)
items.text: Apply MP grease to the oil seal lip.

content.description: Illustration showing SST tool driving in new oil seal with oil slinger positioned correctly
